description: Fetch a public URL and get its content only if it really loaded. Use it when a page comes back as a block page, CAPTCHA, login wall or empty JavaScript shell, or when you need to know the content is real. It checks the page, retries through other routes (including a headless browser) automatically, and bills only on success. Works without a key up to a free daily allowance; a free key (500 credits) lifts it. Returns markdown by default. If ok is false, the reason says why (e.g. blocked:cloudflare, http_404, expect_text_missing): don't retry the same URL with the same settings.

expect_text.description: Text that must appear on the page for it to count as loaded, e.g. a product name

max_cost.description: Most credits to pay: 1 static only, 2 (default) allows a browser, 10-25 allows premium unblocking (needs a key)

mode.description: markdown (default, main content), html (raw page), rendered (always use a browser)

name: fetch_page
title: Fetch a web page (verified)
